tasks.title: INV-D-06-regression-ses_1d84f236bffe — Demo 2 sibling-deadlock reproduction (runtime unicast assert + prose mirror-sentence grep)
tasks.description: COORDINATION: T2 shares multi-agent-invariants.test.ts with T1; generator MUST rebase on T1's commit (git pull/rebase the wave branch HEAD) BEFORE editing the file, then append below T1's INV-D-01 regression test. No overlapping edit ranges with T1. Two-part deliverable: (Part A — runtime, in multi-agent-invariants.test.ts) Append it.instance 'INV-D-06-regression-ses_1d84f236bffe'. Use installNeverLoop, then sessions.create root, registerSessionRoot, spawn two siblings task_name='prosecutor' and task_name='defense' under AgentPath.root(). Drain BOTH siblings' spawn-seed mailboxes (per existing INV-D-06 pattern at line 1151). From each sibling: send_message(target: AgentPath.root(), content: '<role> opening'). Then drain root.id and each sibling. Assert: root mailbox contains BOTH openings (prosecutor's + defense's), prosecutor's mailbox is empty (defense never sent to prosecutor), defense's mailbox is empty (prosecutor never sent to defense). This proves the deadlock IS the runtime's correct unicast behavior; the bug was in PROSE (no instruction to address peers directly), not in runtime. The test name 'INV-D-06-regression-ses_1d84f236bffe' must be a distinct it.instance from the existing INV-D-06 at line 1151 (both can coexist; the regression slug pins the diagnostic session). (Part B — prose grep, in test/prose/subagent-prompts.test.ts) Append a new describe block 'Wave 2 — INV-D-06 regression: unicast doctrine pinned in both subagent + root prompts' with two tests: (1) assert multi-agent-root.txt contains the unicast doctrine string 'unicast' (this duplicates existing Wave 1 coverage but pins the regression slug; acceptable redundancy per WAVE.md), AND assert it contains a stronger explicit phrase such as 'no broadcast' — both substrings must appear in the same file; (2) assert multi-agent-subagent.txt contains a mirror unicast sentence — the literal substring 'unicast' must appear in multi-agent-subagent.txt (the D7-mirror sentence Wave 1 T1 added). Use the same Bun.file().text() + expect(...).toContain pattern as existing Wave 1 tests in the file. If the mirror substring is absent from multi-agent-subagent.txt, this is a Wave 1 gap → emit ABORT(spec_wrong) recommending Wave 1 amendment, do not silently fix. Verify recipe: `bun test ./test/integration/multi-agent-invariants.test.ts -t 'INV-D-06-regression-ses_1d84f236bffe'` AND `bun test test/prose/subagent-prompts.test.ts`.
